sections.name: Walk
sections.description: ONE LAP OF TWO, AT THE SOURCE RATE. The 47-frame source is the same stride played twice: ink width peaks at 7/16 and again at 29/40, passes narrow at 12 and 34, and frame 23 (x[362..727], w 365) is frame 0 (x[370..739], w 369) again to within four pixels. So 0-22 is the whole cycle and 23-46 is a repeat — shipping both would double the texture for nothing and put a resample seam in the middle. EVERY frame of that lap, not every second one: the first cut was 12 frames at 16fps, which is a new pose every 63ms against the Agbero walk's 33ms, and it read as a limp next to him. Same wall-clock cadence either way (23/30 = 0.767s), but twice the temporal resolution. The stance extremes (the plants) are frames 7 and 16.
